test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 10 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Who among the following Indian shooters won the gold at the International Shooting Sport Federation's Presideut's Cup 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rudrankksh Patil.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rudrankksh Patil** won the** gold** at the International Shooting Sport Federation's **President's Cup 2022.**
 
• Patil is an** Indian shooter **who competes in the **10m air rifle event**.
 
• He won the 10m air rifle championship in **December 2022.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Arjun Babuta** is also an **Indian shooter** who has won several medals in international competitions.

 
 
• He competes in the **10-meter air rifle** events and hails from** Chandigarh. **
 
 
 
• **Anjum Moudgil** is an Indian **female shooter** who has won multiple medals in international competitions.
 
 
• She represents** Punjab **and hails from **Chandigarh.**
 
• She receives assistance from the **Rahul Dravid Athlete Mentorship Program** of the GoSports Foundation.
 
 
 
• **Ankur Mittal** is an Indian **male shooter **who competes in the double trap event.
 
 
• In the 2018 ISSF World Shooting Championships in Changwon, South Korea, he **won gold **in the Double Trap event.
 
• In the 2017 ISSF World Shotgun Championships in Moscow, Russia, he took home a **silver medal. **
